title: Wonderful app
body:
I’ve just started using it and it has helped me so much. The interface is easy to navigate, which I love, as well as the free version offering enough features for me to use it properly. I recommend this app to anyone looking to either quit or develop habits! 🙌
The only problem I have experienced with it is that I use the widget to keep track of what I need to do, but even if it’s a new day, it keeps saying “everything is done”, which is kind of annoying.
author: Sharifa Z.
